headline: Kirloskar Electric issues corrigendum on preferential share funds
hook: Clarification on preferential issue fund usage
summary: Kirloskar Electric Company has released a corrigendum regarding the allocation of funds raised through its preferential issue. The update was issued in connection with the company's Annual General Meeting. This filing clarifies how the proceeds from the equity issuance will be utilized by the firm. Retail investors should note this as it impacts the company's capital deployment strategy.
why_it_matters: Clarifies how company capital is being deployed for operations.
